<?php
class ProducerBase214 { public static function capture($saved,$ignored) { echo "PRODUCER;",self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $saved; } }
class ProducerScope214 extends ProducerBase214 { public static function launch() { global $owner,$argument; return $owner->MiSsInG(self::capture($argument,shift214())); } } class ProducerChild214 extends ProducerScope214 {}
function shift214() { $GLOBALS["argument"] = new New214; $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; } class Old214 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New214 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Base214 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"] = null; echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } } class Derived214 extends Base214 {}
$argument = new Old214; $owner = new Derived214; $child = ProducerChild214::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof Old214) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class Ancestor214 { public static function seed() { echo "SEED;",self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return true; } } class Middle214 extends Ancestor214 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(parent::seed(),false); } } class Final214 extends Middle214 {}
class ParentMagic214 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments[0] === true && $arguments[1] === false) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ParentMagic214; $value = Final214::launch(); echo $value === 9 ? "OK;" : "BAD;";

<?php
class Lexical214 { public static function seed() { echo "WRONG;"; return 2; } public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(first:static::seed(),later:7); } } class Called214 extends Lexical214 { public static function seed() { echo "SELECTED;",self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return 1.5; } }
class NamedMagic214 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments["first"] === 1.5 && $arguments["later"] === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; return false; } }
$owner = new NamedMagic214; $value = Called214::launch(); echo $value === false ? "OK;" : "BAD;";
